def transform(grid):
    # The 1/7-colored footprint indicates which surrounding zero cells are recolored.
    # For this task the marker footprint is applied via row/column local pattern: each marker
    # contributes color to contiguous zero cells in its own row/column until nonzero boundary.
    g=[r[:] for r in grid]
    R,C=len(g),len(g[0])
    marks=[(r,c) for r in range(R) for c in range(C) if g[r][c] in (1,7)]
    for r,c in marks:
        # marker shape is a stencil; expand along horizontal/vertical lines over zeros
        for dr,dc in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
            rr,cc=r+dr,c+dc
            while 0<=rr<R and 0<=cc<C and g[rr][cc]==0:
                g[rr][cc]=1 if grid[r][c]==1 else 7
                rr+=dr; cc+=dc
    return g
PY
